message.content: Starting triage on the reported controller force violation — shrinking to a minimal case.
Shrink preserved the violation — now replaying and inspecting the failure point.
The violating force is far above the limit, so I'll trace the lead-up to pinpoint the cause.
Early signs point to an unclamped force law — checking intermediate steps to confirm.
Step 15 is clamped at the limit but step 16 spikes — examining earlier steps to isolate the trigger.
Force is exactly at the limit until the final step — now hunting what changes at step 16.
The body is closing on its waypoint as the force jumps — pulling the full timeline to test waypoint arrival.
Force holds exactly at the clamp until the final step as the body nears its waypoint — testing whether arrival logic drops the clamp.
